title: Load Control Equipment Terms for the Demand Response Programs
content:
**Equipment.** Under the Demand Response Programs, a program that requires a device does not become active until a qualifying device is installed and communicating. The device that carries out the load reduction, who owns it, and the number of calendar days after the enrollment date within which it must be installed and communicating are set for each program as follows.

| Program | Device required before activation | Device that carries out load reduction | Installation period (calendar days after enrollment) | Device owned by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | No | None | 0 | Not applicable |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | Yes | Customer-owned qualifying Wi-Fi smart thermostat controlling central air conditioning | 30 | Customer |
| AC Cycling Program | Yes | Company-installed load control switch on the outdoor air conditioning unit | 45 | Company |
| Home Battery Dispatch | Yes | Customer-owned qualifying home battery with company-approved dispatch software | 60 | Customer |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | No | None; the customer curtails its own load | 0 | Not applicable |
| Base Interruptible Program | No | None; the customer reduces load to its firm service level | 0 | Not applicable |

An installation period of 0 days means that no device is required for that program.

## Equipment by program

- **Smart Thermostat Rewards** — the customer owns the thermostat; it must be a qualifying Wi-Fi smart thermostat that controls central air conditioning. Installation period: 30 calendar days.
- **AC Cycling Program** — the company installs and owns the load control switch, which sits on the outdoor air conditioning unit. Installation period: 45 calendar days.
- **Home Battery Dispatch** — the customer owns the battery, which must be a qualifying home battery running company-approved dispatch software. Installation period: 60 calendar days.
- **Peak Time Rebate** — no device.
- **Commercial Capacity Bidding Program** — no device; the customer curtails its own load.
- **Base Interruptible Program** — no device; the customer reduces load to its firm service level.

## Questions on equipment

**Which programs require a device before activation?** Smart Thermostat Rewards, the AC Cycling Program and Home Battery Dispatch.

**Who owns an AC Cycling switch?** The company; the switch is company-installed.

**Is any device required for a business program?** No. Neither business program requires a device.
